description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the 'Delegator' component in the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically testing various ways of creating Delegator instances and handling configuration issues.

classes.name: DelegatorUnitTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the creation and behavior of Delegator instances within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up system properties and disables error logging before each test.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores previous error logging settings after each test.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingConstructorFailsIfConfigurationIsMissing
methods.description: Tests that creating a Delegator with a non-existent configuration throws a GenericEntityException with appropriate message.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingConstructor
methods.description: Validates basic creation of a Delegator using its constructor with a valid configuration.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingFactoryGetInstance
methods.description: Checks that the factory creates different Delegator instances with the same name.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingFactoryGetDelegator
methods.description: Verifies that the factory returns the same Delegator instance for repeated requests with the same name.

methods.name: delegatorCreationUsingFactoryReturnsNullIfConfigurationIsMissing
methods.description: Tests that requesting a Delegator with missing configuration via the factory returns null (not throws an exception).
